Target category: access_control
Threat model: records is a trusted server-side dictionary; record_id is attacker-controlled; actor comes from a trusted authenticated session. Only the owner may read a record. Sharing a tenant or being logged in alone does not authorize a read. Missing records must return None.

def read_record(records, actor, record_id):
    def allowed(record):
        return record is not None and record["owner_id"] == actor["id"]
    record = records.get(record_id)
    return record if allowed(record) else None
